note: v48.0 Day 139 (36-day catch-up). F1–F6 resolved at horizon; F7 OBE-retired (Knesset dissolves 2026-07-17). Islamabad MOU signed 2026-06-17 collapsed 2026-07-08; US resumed blockade + strikes; Iran refuses talks. 6 new active forecasts. Escalation reweighted 55/30/15.

forecasts.question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?
forecasts.delta_reason: The Pakistan-mediated Islamabad Talks formally convened June 12-14, producing the text of the Islamabad Memorandum announced by Pakistan PM Sharif on June 12; JD Vance confirmed digital signing on June 14-15. Arms Control Association and Wikipedia confirm these were formally convened sessions in Islamabad brokered by Pakistan, satisfying the 'mediated via Pakistan' criterion before EOD June 16. RESOLVED-YES.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-06-16, a publicly confirmed HELD negotiating session (direct or mediated via Oman/Qatar/Pakistan) occurs between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, OR an official Iranian statement (MFA/state media IRNA/Tasnim/Fars) rescinds the 2026-06-01 suspension. A held mediated session counts; mere rhetorical assertion that 'talks continue' or relay of written messages does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official Iranian state-media; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also resolves.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Trump-only assertions without Iranian/mediator confirmation do NOT count; written-message exchanges that are not a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Iranian MFA spokesman confirms re-engagement or rescinds suspension
Omani/Qatari/Pakistani mediator readout of a convened/held session

forecasts.question: Will a TIER1-confirmed convened US-Iran negotiating session occur before EOD 2026-06-24?
forecasts.delta_reason: The Switzerland/Lake Lucerne talks of June 22 were TIER1-confirmed by Al Jazeera, CNBC, and NPR as a formally convened session between named principals (VP JD Vance, Iran's Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf), co-brokered by Qatar and Pakistan — satisfying resolution criteria before EOD June 24. Judge note: Switzerland as venue (vs. Oman/Qatar/Pakistan as named hosts in the criteria) was assessed as satisfied by Pakistan/Qatar's explicit co-brokering role per the joint Pakistan-Qatar readout. RESOLVED-YES.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session between named US and Iranian principals/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar), between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Axios/Al Jazeera/Times of Israel; State Dept or Iran MFA statement also qualifies.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Mere relay of written messages, or one side asserting talks 'continue' without a named convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: TIER1 report of a convened session
Iran MFA statement lifting the June 1 suspension

forecasts.question: Will a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange (strikes both ways) occur in any 48h window before EOD 2026-06-24?
forecasts.delta_reason: No direct Israel-Iran bilateral exchange within a 48h window occurred in the June 10-24 window. The preceding June 7-8 exchange (IDF strikes on Tehran/Isfahan/Tabriz + Iranian ballistic missile response) fell outside the window. The June 14 IDF strike on Beirut/Lebanon did not target Iranian territory; Iranian retaliation was held back by US intervention. The June 17 Islamabad MOU created a ceasefire framework that structurally suppressed bilateral exchanges through June 24. Per resolution criteria requiring BOTH Israeli strikes on Iranian targets AND Iranian strikes on Israeli targets within the same 48h window: only one direction was present on June 14. RESOLVED-NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a publicly confirmed direct Israel-Iran military exchange — Israeli strikes on Iranian targets AND Iranian strikes on Israeli/Israeli-claimed targets — within any rolling 48h window between 2026-06-10 and 2026-06-24.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/CNN/Al Jazeera) OR one TIER1 + official Israeli (IDF) or Iranian (IRGC) statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Proxy-only attacks (Hezbollah/Houthi) without direct Iran-Israel state strikes do NOT count; one-directional strikes within the 48h window = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: IDF + IRGC reciprocal strike statements within 48h
TIER1 confirmation of two-way strikes in a single window

forecasts.question: Will Hormuz reach >=50 commercial transits/day (7-day avg) before EOD 2026-07-02?
forecasts.delta_reason: Hormuz transit recovery was too gradual: US CENTCOM commenced MCM operations June 16 and the MOU was signed June 17, producing a partial recovery to single-day peaks of approximately 51-52 vessels on June 24-25. However, the 7-day moving average never reached 50 in any rolling window before July 2. The July 6-7 vessel strikes and July 8 MOU collapse then reversed the recovery entirely. F4's own ambiguity rule ('one-off surge days below a 7-day window do NOT qualify') governs: single-day peaks of 51-52 are not a sustained 7-day average. RESOLVED-NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if IMF PortWatch (or equivalent AIS) records >=50 commercial transits/day averaged over any consecutive 7-day window between 2026-06-02 and 2026-07-02.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IMF PortWatch + one TIER1/OSINT shipping report (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval-escorted convoys count; one-off surge days below a 7-day window do NOT qualify; if PortWatch unpublished, use best AIS tracker and flag AMBIGUOUS if sources conflict >20%.

indicators.name: PortWatch 7-day transit trend rising
P&I war-risk cover reinstated for Hormuz transit

forecasts.question: Will mine-countermeasure clearing operations actively commence in Hormuz before EOD 2026-07-10?
forecasts.delta_reason: US CENTCOM commenced mine-countermeasure clearing operations in the Strait of Hormuz on June 16, 2026 — the day after the Islamabad MOU framework announcement. Gulf News, Al Jazeera, and UANI confirm commencement of actual operations (not merely positioning). Additionally, France deployed dedicated mine-countermeasure assets to the region by July 4 (Republic World, ANI News, Eastern Herald), with UK-led coalition operations commencing under Oman authorization. Multiple independent TIER1 sources confirmed commencement well within the June 10 – July 10 window. RESOLVED-YES.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports mine-countermeasure vessels/operations have actively commenced clearing the Strait of Hormuz (US/coalition/third-party) between 2026-06-10 and 2026-07-10.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Bloomberg/CNBC, or a named US/UK/coalition naval/Pentagon statement carried by TIER1.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Stated intent, vessel positioning, or planning without confirmed commencement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: TIER1/Pentagon report of MCM operations commencing
Lloyd's List clearance-lane announcement or uptick toward >10 transits/day

forecasts.question: Will the Knesset pass the dissolution bill's final reading with a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27 before EOD 2026-07-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: Both subconditions for YES failed: (1) The dissolution bill's final (third) reading was not passed before EOD July 15 — the Knesset legal adviser Sagit Afik and Speaker Ohana designated July 17 as the dissolution date, two days after the F6 horizon. (2) The fixed election date is October 27, 2026 — explicitly NOT earlier than 2026-10-27. Times of Israel (July 2026): 'Knesset expected to dissolve July 17, paving way for October 27 election.' Israel Hayom confirmed the election date as October 27 on July 12. F6's resolution criteria require BOTH the final reading before EOD July 15 AND an election date earlier than Oct 27; neither condition was met. RESOLVED-NO.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if the Knesset passes the dissolution bill in final (third) reading AND that passage specifies a fixed election date earlier than 2026-10-27, before EOD 2026-07-15.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two TIER1 (Times of Israel/Reuters/AP/JPost) citing the Knesset plenum vote record.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Preliminary/first/second readings without final passage do NOT count; passage that leaves the date to a later committee or sets only a band without a fixed date = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; if a fixed date on/after 27 Oct is set, resolve NO.

indicators.name: Plenum third-reading dissolution vote held with a fixed date inserted
Haredi-coalition agreement on a fixed September/Oct-20 date

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's coalition lose its Knesset majority or dissolve early before 2026-10-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: OBE-RETIRED. The Knesset dissolves July 17, 2026 — the day after this report — under the coalition's own dissolution bill. The scenario F7 tracked (a loss of majority below 61 seats, or an election called earlier than Oct 27) did not materialize in the form envisioned: the coalition passed the dissolution bill with 106 votes in favor (unanimous), the election is set for Oct 27 (not earlier), and caretaker government continues. The question is now logically moot: the Knesset ceasing to exist July 17 makes further weekly monitoring of coalition majority status incoherent. Replaced by N6 (F6-new: Likud-leads-coalition after Oct 27 election).
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a Knesset roll-call vote confirms coalition loss of majority (61 seats), OR if Netanyahu announces early dissolution and election date moves earlier than 2026-10-27. NO if coalition survives to mandatory election date with 61+ seats intact.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Knesset official record + Reuters/Haaretz/Times of Israel. Polling alone does not resolve.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If coalition drops below 61 but Netanyahu remains caretaker PM until election: YES. If a single party departs but coalition retains 61+: NO. Reviewed weekly only (Sundays); no intra-week deltas.

indicators.name: Smotrich formally departs coalition
Degel HaTorah files formal dissolution motion in Knesset

forecasts.question: Will Iran announce an official halt or suspension of counter-strikes against US military assets before EOD 2026-07-19?
forecasts.delta_reason: Iran Foreign Ministry spokesperson Baghaei stated on July 16 that Iran has 'no plans for negotiations' and is 'focused on defending the country'; IRGC struck a US military base in Jordan with ballistic missiles on July 15 in response to US strikes near a Tehran children's hospital. Under the current US strike tempo — CENTCOM expanding to targets around Tehran and Iran's missile province — Iran is extremely unlikely to announce a formal halt within 72h. The 20% accounts for the possibility that Trump's threatened infrastructure strikes (power plants, bridges) could trigger an Iranian tactical pause to buy negotiating space via Qatar/Pakistan channels.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if an official Iranian MFA statement or IRGC command spokesperson publicly announces a halt, suspension, or cessation of counter-strikes against US military assets, carried by IRNA or two independent TIER1 sources, before EOD 2026-07-19.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IRNA or two independent TIER1 sources (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera/CNN). A named MFA or IRGC spokesperson statement required.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: A tactical lull in strikes without an official announcement does NOT count; 'maximum restraint' or 'defensive posture only' language without explicit halt announcement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; proxy strikes by Hezbollah or Houthis are not Iranian state strikes and do not trigger resolution.

indicators.name: IRGC General or MFA spokesperson publicly announces strike suspension
indicators.expected_effect: +50pp toward YES if announced by named official

indicators.name: No Iranian strikes on US or allied military assets for 24+ consecutive hours
indicators.expected_effect: +10pp behavioral indicator; does not alone resolve

forecasts.question: Will a formally convened US-Iran negotiating session (direct or via named mediator) be held before EOD 2026-07-30?
forecasts.delta_reason: Iran FM Baghaei confirmed on July 16 that Iran has 'no plans for negotiations'; Trump stated on July 15-16 that strikes would intensify unless Iran 'gets to the table,' explicitly threatening power plants and bridges from next week. Qatar and Pakistan confirmed shuttle diplomacy continuing as of July 14 (Pakistan Today). The 30% reflects the structural tension: Iran's stated refusal to negotiate vs. the escalating threat of infrastructure strikes that may create conditions for Iran to recalculate. The June-to-MOU precedent took 16 days from suspension to formal session; a comparable cycle could produce talks by July 30.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a formally convened direct or indirect negotiating session — in person or by confirmed videoconference — between named US and Iranian principals or senior envoys, with a named mediator or host (Oman, Qatar, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, or any UN-endorsed host), between 2026-07-16 and 2026-07-30.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 sources (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera/CNN/CNBC) OR one TIER1 + official US State Dept or Iran MFA statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Written message exchanges, relay diplomacy, or mediator shuttle visits without a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; Trump or US-side claims of talks 'continuing' without Iranian confirmation of a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Iran MFA or Araghchi confirms a session is scheduled or has been held
Qatar PM or Pakistan PM announces a convened session readout

forecasts.question: Will coalition mine-clearing operations in the Strait of Hormuz actively resume before EOD 2026-08-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: UK-France coalition minehunting vessels deployed to the region by July 4-6 (RFA Lyme Bay as mother ship; France's two minehunters) and were in position to begin limited operations in Omani waters before the July 6-7 vessel strikes forced a suspension. The July 8 MOU collapse and CENTCOM naval blockade created an operational environment in which MCM operations carry strike risk. Approximately 80 mines remain in the main navigation channel. Resumption within 30 days requires either a new ceasefire framework or unilateral UK/France decision to operate under hostile conditions — both of which remain possible given European energy exposure.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source confirms mine-countermeasure operations (US, UK, French, or multinational coalition) have actively recommenced in the Strait of Hormuz or its Omani approaches, between 2026-07-16 and 2026-08-15.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Reuters/AP/AFP/Bloomberg/Lloyd's List OR named UK/France/US naval command or Pentagon statement confirmed by TIER1.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Vessel positioning, movement into theater, or stated intent without confirmed active operations = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; coalition MCM in Omani waters on the main navigation corridor counts; MCM in Persian Gulf proper (not Hormuz) does not.

indicators.name: UK or French naval command confirms MCM sortie or mine neutralization in Hormuz corridor
New US-Iran ceasefire or framework explicitly authorizes coalition MCM operations

forecasts.question: Will the Strait of Hormuz reach >=30 commercial transits/day (7-day avg) before EOD 2026-09-15?
forecasts.delta_reason: Hormuz transits collapsed from single-day peaks of ~52 (June 24-25) to approximately 10/day by July 12-16 (UANI data) following the MOU collapse, resumed CENTCOM naval blockade, and July 6-8 vessel strikes. Approximately 80 mines remain in the main navigation corridor. P&I war-risk insurance is running at ~8× pre-crisis levels with 6 major clubs having withdrawn cover. Reaching 30/day (7-day average) within 61 days requires resumed MCM operations and insurer re-engagement — neither established in current posture. 25% reflects the ~90-day time-constant for previous Hormuz recovery cycles under more favorable conditions.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if IMF PortWatch or equivalent AIS tracker (Straits.live, Lloyd's List, Refinitiv) records >=30 commercial transits/day averaged over any consecutive 7-day window between 2026-07-16 and 2026-09-15.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: IMF PortWatch (primary) + one TIER1 shipping report (Reuters/Bloomberg/Lloyd's List); if PortWatch unavailable, two independent AIS aggregators required.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval-escorted convoys count toward the transit total; one-off surge days not part of a 7-day average do not qualify; data gap >3 consecutive days in PortWatch = AMBIGUOUS-OPEN until data restored.

indicators.name: PortWatch 7-day transit average rising above 15/day (trend confirmation)
indicators.expected_effect: +20pp toward YES if trend established for 7 consecutive days

forecasts.question: Will the US and Iran agree to a new written ceasefire framework (MOU or equivalent) before EOD 2026-09-30?
forecasts.delta_reason: The Islamabad MOU (June 17) collapsed by July 8 after approximately 21 days. Both parties retain structural incentives for a second framework: Iran faces economic devastation from the Hormuz closure and US strikes; the US faces energy price shocks and allied pressure. The prior MOU took approximately 16 days from Iran's June 1 suspension to the June 17 signing — suggesting a new framework within the 76-day window is plausible if the current escalation cycle runs its course. Qatar and Pakistan confirmed shuttle diplomacy continuing July 14. 40% reflects meaningful probability given both sides' structural vulnerabilities, balanced against Iran's current 'no negotiations' posture and Trump's stated intention to escalate to infrastructure.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if the US and Iran publicly confirm a new written ceasefire agreement, MOU, or equivalent framework document reducing active hostilities, between 2026-07-16 and 2026-09-30, with acknowledgment from both governments confirmed by TIER1.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/CNBC/Al Jazeera) OR one TIER1 + official statements from both US State Dept and Iran MFA.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Verbal announcements without a signed or digitally confirmed text = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; a ceasefire that only one party announces = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO; a tactical pause in strikes lasting <72h without a signed framework = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Qatar or Pakistan PM announces a draft framework text has been agreed
Iran MFA formally reverses 'no negotiations' stance in official statement

forecasts.question: Will Netanyahu's Likud lead a governing coalition with >=61 seats after the 2026-10-27 Israeli election?
forecasts.delta_reason: Knesset dissolves July 17; election confirmed for October 27, 2026. Most recent published poll (Haaretz, July 9) shows Eisenkot's party overtaking Likud for the first time, with opposition bloc projected at 69 seats versus the coalition's 51 — a 18-seat deficit for Netanyahu. Historically, Israeli security emergencies produce incumbency boosts; the Iran war context could help Netanyahu. However, the economic cost of the Hormuz closure, the ongoing Iran strikes casualty counts, and the Gaza humanitarian situation create headwinds. 35% reflects the opposition's current lead tempered by the documented pattern of Israeli security-rally voting.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, following the October 27, 2026 election, Netanyahu's Likud-led bloc publicly announces a coalition agreement with named parties totaling >=61 Knesset seats, confirmed by Israeli Electoral Commission results and two TIER1 sources.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Israeli Electoral Commission official results + two TIER1 (Haaretz/Times of Israel/Reuters/AP). Coalition formation announcement must include named parties and seat count.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: A provisional coalition agreement without explicit seat-count confirmation from the Electoral Commission = AMBIGUOUS-OPEN until finalized; if election is postponed past EOD Oct 27 due to war conditions, forecast extends to the new official date with OPEN-AMBIGUOUS status.

indicators.name: Pre-election poll average showing Likud-led bloc at >=55 seats for 2+ consecutive weeks
indicators.expected_effect: +15pp toward YES if sustained average established

indicators.name: Major Iran/security development before election day producing clear incumbency rally
